groups.description: Proposed groups of incidents evidencing the same behavioral pattern

signal.description: A short phrase that CAPTURES what all these incidents have in common at the behavioral level — the UNDERLYING PATTERN that these different expressions all point to. NOT a {label_name}, just a descriptive label. E.g.: 'extended work hours', 'performing for evaluators'

incident_ids.description: EXACT incident IDs from the input that evidence this pattern. At least 2.

rationale.description: One sentence explaining the UNDERLYING BEHAVIORAL PROCESS that connects these incidents, despite their surface differences

needs_retry.description: true if you consider your output is incomplete, low quality, or requires additional refinement

retry_reason.description: ONLY if needs_retry=true. CONCRETE and ACTIONABLE instruction on what to improve in the next attempt. E.g.: 'Label too generic — specify distinctive properties', 'Missing evidence from segment 47', 'Definition mixes two different concepts — separate'

suggested_action.description: Recommended action: proceed (output correct, continue), retry (retry with feedback), escalate_to_hitl (human decision needed), skip (skip this agent, not relevant), abort (unrecoverable error, stop everything)
